_comment: Описания для tools/genart_batch.py. Ключ — уровень (для --only), значение — имя файла в Content/art без расширения → что рисовать. Стиль задаётся не здесь, а референсом и шаблоном в genart_batch.py.

sabines.char_romulus: Romulus, first king of Rome: a young warrior-king with tousled dark hair, a grey wolf pelt over one shoulder, simple bronze circlet, short red tunic, leather sandals, a spear in one hand
sabines.char_hersilia: Hersilia, a young Sabine woman: long dark hair in a thick braid, saffron-yellow dress with a blue shawl, bronze pin at the shoulder, brave and worried expression
sabines.char_tatius: Titus Tatius, king of the Sabines: a stocky older man with a grey beard, plain bronze helmet, dark blue woollen cloak, heavy round shield on his back
sabines.scene_consualia: an ancient rustic Roman festival ground at the foot of a hill: wooden stands, garlands, an altar smoking, a race track marked with poles, late afternoon light, empty of people
sabines.scene_asylum_hill: a rough hilltop refuge in earliest Rome: a palisade of stakes, huts with thatched roofs, an open gate, scrubby oaks, morning haze over the Tiber valley
sabines.scene_sabine_war: two armies about to meet on a dusty plain between low hills, dropped spears and standards planted in the ground, dust in the air, no figures
sabines.scene_between_lines: a narrow strip of trampled ground between two facing battle lines seen from the side, spears raised on both edges of the frame, an empty gap in the middle, tense dusty light

lucretia.char_sextus: Sextus Tarquinius, an Etruscan-Roman prince: young man with oiled dark curls, purple-bordered tunic, gold arm ring, a sly arrogant smile, hand on a dagger hilt
lucretia.char_lucretia: Lucretia, a Roman matron: modest white stola with a dark red mantle, hair bound in a simple knot, calm and grave face, holding a spindle
lucretia.char_junius: Lucius Junius Brutus: a Roman nobleman in a plain undyed toga, unkempt dark hair, deliberately blank simpleton's expression that hides sharp eyes, a rod of office in his hand
lucretia.char_tarquin: Tarquin the Proud, last king of Rome: a haughty older king in a deep purple robe with gold embroidery, heavy gold crown, black beard streaked with grey, cruel narrow eyes
lucretia.scene_collatia: the dim inner room of an early Roman house at night: a low bed with red covers, an oil lamp guttering on a stand, a loom in the corner, shutters half open to darkness
lucretia.scene_dagger_oath: an austere Roman atrium at dawn: a shallow rain pool, a wooden bench, a dagger lying on the floor tiles, cold blue morning light through the roof opening
lucretia.scene_king_court: the audience hall of an Etruscan-style palace: heavy painted columns, a raised throne on a dais, bronze braziers, gaudy frescoes of banquets, oppressive warm light
lucretia.scene_forum_rouse: the early Roman forum crowded with empty speaker's platform: the rostra of rough stone, wooden market stalls shuttered, temple steps behind, torches burning in daylight

mucius.char_porsenna: Lars Porsenna, an Etruscan king: an imposing man in a tall conical embroidered hat, richly patterned cloak with fringe, curled grey beard, gold pectoral
mucius.char_mucius: Gaius Mucius Scaevola: a lean young Roman in a plain grey tunic, jaw set, his right hand blackened and scorched, a short dagger in his left hand
mucius.char_cocles: Horatius Cocles: a broad-shouldered Roman soldier, crested bronze helmet, big oval shield, mud to the knees, one eye scarred shut, planted stance
mucius.char_cloelia: Cloelia: a teenage Roman girl in a soaked plain tunic, wet hair plastered to her neck, bare feet, defiant chin up
mucius.scene_sublician: an old wooden pile bridge over a wide muddy river, half its planks already torn up, axes and beams on the near end, smoke on the far bank
mucius.scene_etruscan_camp: an Etruscan army paymaster's tent at night: a table heaped with coins and wax tablets, a strongbox, soldiers' cloaks on stools, oil lamps, tent canvas, no figures
mucius.scene_tiber_swim: the broad Tiber at dusk seen from the reedy bank, current dark and fast, an abandoned rope and a wooden stake on the shore, hills beyond
mucius.scene_exile_tent: the cramped tent of an exiled king: a folding stool, a rolled map, a dusty crown resting on a chest, a single lamp, shadows on canvas
mucius.char_scribe_e: an Etruscan royal scribe: a well-dressed clerk in an embroidered robe with gold trim, wax tablets and a stylus in hand, soft self-important face, clearly mistakable for a king at a glance
mucius.scene_brazier_m: an Etruscan king's tent interior: a bronze brazier of glowing coals on a tripod in the centre, a folding throne with a purple cloth behind it, spears of guards leaning at the edges, hot red light, no figures
mucius.char_scribe_e_dead: an Etruscan royal scribe struck down: the same well-dressed clerk in an embroidered robe with gold trim, slumped kneeling on the ground, head drooping, eyes drawn as simple X crosses, wax tablets and stylus dropped from his limp hands

secession.char_menenius: Menenius Agrippa: a genial elderly Roman patrician in a white toga, bald crown with white fringe of hair, one hand raised mid-story, warm crinkled eyes
secession.char_sicinius: Lucius Sicinius, leader of the plebs: a weather-beaten farmer-soldier in a coarse brown tunic, rope belt, work-scarred hands, a stout staff, stubborn set to his mouth
secession.char_appius: Appius Claudius: a severe patrician, hawk nose, thin lips, dark toga with a broad purple stripe, arms crossed
secession.char_coriolanus: Coriolanus: a proud young Roman general in a muscled bronze cuirass and red cloak, chin lifted in scorn, sword at his hip
secession.scene_mons_sacer: a bare green hill above a river valley at dawn, a rough camp of the common people: cooking fires, carts, bundles, a single standard of plaited straw, the distant city small on the horizon
secession.scene_plebs_parley: a meeting place in the open air between camp and city: a flat rock used as a table, two empty stools facing each other, olive trees, mid-morning light
secession.scene_curia_hard: the interior of an early senate house: tiers of hard wooden benches, a bare stone floor, narrow high windows throwing cold shafts of light, austere and cheerless
secession.scene_tribune_grant: a small formal chamber with a bronze tablet of law being set into the wall, a curule chair, scroll cases, warm lamplight

brennus.char_brennus: Brennus, a Gaulish chieftain: tall barbarian with long lime-washed red hair and a drooping moustache, thick gold torc, chequered trousers, mail over a bare chest, a long iron sword
brennus.char_camillus: Marcus Furius Camillus: a dignified Roman general, iron-grey hair, muscled cuirass, deep red cloak, calm commanding face, baton in hand
brennus.char_manlius: Marcus Manlius Capitolinus: an alert Roman soldier at night, cloak pulled close, round shield, tousled hair, wide watchful eyes
brennus.char_sulpicius: Quintus Sulpicius, a Roman tribune: a middle-aged man in a toga, holding a small bronze balance-scale, humiliated angry expression
brennus.scene_allia: a bleak river plain strewn with dropped Roman shields and standards, a grey sky, crows, a shallow stream, no figures
brennus.scene_capitol_geese: the Capitoline citadel wall at night from inside: rough stone parapet, a sacred goose pen with white geese, the temple roof behind, moonlight and one torch
brennus.scene_gold_scales: a large bronze balance-scale set up in a ruined forum, heaps of gold coins and cups in one pan, burnt buildings around, ash falling
brennus.scene_veii_return: a Roman army column arriving on a road above the smoking city at dawn, standards and spears in silhouette on the ridge, no faces visible

corvus.char_duilius: Gaius Duilius, a Roman consul: solid middle-aged man in a bronze cuirass decorated with a ship's prow, red cloak, sea-weathered face, confident half-smile
corvus.char_regulus: Marcus Atilius Regulus: a stern lean Roman consul, deep-lined face, close-cropped grey hair, plain cuirass, grim mouth
corvus.char_gisco: a Carthaginian admiral: dark curled beard, conical felt cap, deep purple tunic with gold hem, heavy earrings, hand resting on a curved sword
corvus.scene_ostia_yard: a Roman shipyard on a river mouth: half-built warship hulls on stocks, stacked timber, a huge boarding-bridge with an iron spike lying ready, sawdust and rope, bright noon
corvus.scene_mylae_sea: a blue Sicilian sea with empty warship decks close together, oars and rams, wooden boarding bridge lowered between two hulls, spray, no crew visible
corvus.scene_rostra_column: a marble column on the Roman forum studded with bronze ship prows, laurel garlands at its base, clear sky

fabius.char_fabius: Quintus Fabius Maximus: an unhurried elderly Roman dictator, grey beard, plain red cloak over a simple cuirass, walking staff, patient unreadable face
fabius.char_minucius: Marcus Minucius Rufus: a hot-tempered young Roman officer, tall red horsehair crest, flushed face, sword already half drawn
fabius.char_hannibal: Hannibal Barca: a Carthaginian general with a short dark curled beard, one eye lost and lidded shut, scale armour under a dust-red cloak, a small elephant emblem on his shoulder guard, cold intelligent stare
fabius.scene_shadow_march: a high rocky ridge above a wide valley in Italy, a goat path along the crest, burnt fields far below sending up thin smoke, hot hazy afternoon
fabius.scene_torch_oxen: a dark mountain pass at night with scattered points of fire moving along the slope, an abandoned Roman picket post, confusion of smoke and sparks, no figures
fabius.scene_open_battle: an open flat Italian plain prepared for pitched battle: churned soil, a dry stream bed, discarded pila, dust hanging in still air
fabius.scene_rescue_field: the edge of a battlefield at evening: a broken ring of shields, standards leaning, a corridor of trampled ground leading out, low golden light

cannae.char_maharbal: Maharbal, Carthaginian cavalry commander: wiry rider in a short cloak, leather cuirass, a bundle of javelins on his back, sun-dark face, impatient grin
cannae.char_varro: Gaius Terentius Varro: a red-haired Roman consul of plebeian stock, plain cuirass, broad blunt features, loud confident bearing
cannae.char_paullus: Lucius Aemilius Paullus: an aristocratic Roman consul, silver at the temples, finely worked cuirass, tired resigned dignity
cannae.scene_cannae_wing: a battle line seen from above on a dusty plain by a river, the centre of the line deliberately bowed forward into a crescent, no figures, ochre earth
cannae.scene_cannae_field: a wide dusty plain at high summer, a slow brown river on one side, trampled stubble, a hot white sky, oppressive heat shimmer
cannae.scene_cannae_council: a Carthaginian command tent after a victory: a map weighted with daggers, a cup of wine, captured Roman rings in a bowl, lamplight

zama.char_scipio: Publius Cornelius Scipio Africanus: a young Roman general, clean-shaven, dark hair, gilded muscled cuirass, sky-blue cloak, calm charismatic face
zama.char_masinissa: Masinissa, Numidian king: a lean dark-skinned rider in a leopard-skin cloak over a white tunic, gold armlets, no helmet, sharp watchful eyes
zama.char_syphax: Syphax, Numidian king: an older heavier rider in rich striped robes and heavy gold jewellery, ostrich plume in his headband, wary expression
zama.scene_numidia_pact: a Numidian camp on dry African grassland: low tents of striped cloth, tethered horses, a fire with a copper pot, red evening light
zama.scene_zama_lanes: a Roman battle formation seen from above, maniples deliberately drawn apart to leave straight open lanes through the whole depth of the line, dry cracked earth
zama.scene_zama_field: a broad North African plain of pale dust and thorn scrub, distant hills, hard midday sun, elephant tracks in the dust, no figures

delenda.char_cato_elder: Marcus Porcius Cato the Elder: a severe old Roman censor, red hair gone grey, weathered farmer's face, coarse plain toga, holding a fresh fig
delenda.char_nasica: Scipio Nasica: a thoughtful middle-aged Roman senator in a fine toga, one hand raised in cautious objection, worried intelligent face
delenda.char_aemilianus: Scipio Aemilianus: a young Roman general with a melancholy handsome face, plain but excellent cuirass, red cloak, laurel wreath held rather than worn
delenda.char_hasdrubal: Hasdrubal the Boetarch, last defender of Carthage: a soot-stained Carthaginian officer, dented scale armour, torn purple sash, desperate hollow eyes
delenda.scene_punic_harbor: the great circular military harbour of Carthage seen from a terrace: concentric quays, covered ship sheds, masts crowded together, a prosperous white city behind, brilliant sea light
delenda.scene_senate_delenda: the Roman curia interior: tiers of benches, a speaker's floor, a scatter of dropped figs on the marble, shafts of dusty light from high windows
delenda.scene_byrsa_fall: the Byrsa hill of Carthage burning: collapsing terraced houses, narrow streets choked with rubble, orange fire glow through black smoke, no figures
delenda.scene_eshmun_temple: the steps of a Punic temple at the top of a burning citadel: tall columns, a bronze door, votive stelae, smoke drifting across, empty steps

gracchus.char_tiberius: Tiberius Gracchus, a Roman tribune: an earnest young aristocrat in a plain white toga, short dark hair, open honest face, a rolled land-law scroll in one hand, ears of wheat tucked in his belt
gracchus.char_octavius: Marcus Octavius, a Roman tribune: a young man in a white toga, hand raised palm-out in refusal, uncomfortable stubborn expression
gracchus.char_serapio: Scipio Nasica Serapio, a Roman senator: a heavy-set angry senator, toga wrapped tight around his left arm like a shield, gripping a broken wooden bench leg as a club, flushed face
gracchus.scene_depose_rostra: the speaker's platform on the Roman forum during a vote: rough stone rostra decorated with ship prows, voting urns and tablets on a table, an empty magistrate's stool tipped over
gracchus.scene_assembly_g: a Roman popular assembly ground: roped voting pens of wood, a raised tribunal, wheat fields painted on a banner, bright noon, empty of people
gracchus.scene_veto_rostra: the same forum platform seen closer at dusk, a single bronze tablet of law half covered by a cloth, torn voting tablets scattered, cold shadow across the stones
gracchus.scene_capitol_mob: the steps below the Capitoline temple in disorder: smashed wooden benches, broken bench legs and a torn toga on the ground, blood-dark stains on stone, harsh afternoon light, no figures

marius.char_marius: Gaius Marius, a Roman general of humble birth: broad blunt peasant features, close-cropped grey hair, plain functional cuirass without ornament, heavy jaw, hard confident stare
marius.char_metellus: Quintus Caecilius Metellus, an aristocratic Roman general: sleek grey hair, finely decorated gilded cuirass, patrician disdain, a commander's baton
marius.char_jugurtha: Jugurtha, king of Numidia: a sinewy North African king in a white robe with a purple border, gold diadem over black braided hair, sharp cunning smile, curved dagger at his belt
marius.char_sulla: Lucius Cornelius Sulla: a Roman commander with striking pale blue eyes, reddish-blond hair, a blotchy red-and-white complexion, an immaculate cuirass and red cloak, a thin unsettling smile
marius.scene_head_count: a Roman recruiting ground outside the city: a table with enlistment rolls, stacked plain shields and packs, barefoot poor men's sandals lined up, dusty morning
marius.scene_senate_command: the interior of the Roman senate house with a map of North Africa on a stand, benches, an hourglass of sand, cold formal light
marius.scene_numidia_war: a North African desert battlefield: ochre dunes and dry riverbed, palm trees, an abandoned Numidian standard in the sand, harsh white sun
marius.scene_bocchus_tent: a rich Moorish royal tent: striped carpets, low table with dates and a silver jug, hanging lamps, a leopard skin on the floor, conspiratorial half-light
marius.char_bocchus: Bocchus, king of Mauretania: a shrewd elderly Berber king in a striped desert robe with a gold circlet over a white headcloth, grey beard, calculating half-smile

sulla_march.char_lucullus: Lucius Lucullus, a young Roman quaestor: neat dark hair, a scholar's calm face, plain officer's cuirass and cloak, a writing tablet tucked under one arm
sulla_march.char_pompeius_rufus: Quintus Pompeius Rufus, a Roman consul: a middle-aged man in a toga with a broad purple stripe, worried decent face, hands spread in refusal
sulla_march.char_sulpicius_r: Publius Sulpicius Rufus, a Roman tribune: a fiery orator in a white toga, dark curly hair, mouth open mid-speech, a scroll clenched in his fist
sulla_march.scene_nola_camp: a Roman legionary camp outside a besieged Italian town: leather tents in ordered rows, a command platform of turf, standards planted, evening cookfires, no figures
sulla_march.scene_march_rome: an empty paved road leading toward the walls and gate of Rome at dawn, a boundary stone of the sacred pomerium in the foreground, cypresses, cold pink light
sulla_march.scene_forum_expel: the Roman forum occupied by soldiers: shields stacked against the rostra, shuttered shops, an overturned bench, smoke from a burnt house, hard midday light, no people

proscriptions.char_flaccus: Lucius Valerius Flaccus, an elderly Roman senator: thin, stooped, white toga, holding a bronze law tablet, resigned expression
proscriptions.char_marius_younger: Gaius Marius the Younger: a young Roman in a dusty military tunic, resemblance to a famous father, defiant frightened eyes
proscriptions.char_caesar_young: the young Julius Caesar at eighteen: a slender teenage Roman patrician in a loose belted tunic, tousled dark hair, stubborn intelligent face, no laurel and no armour
proscriptions.char_crassus: Marcus Licinius Crassus: a well-fed Roman magnate in an expensive toga, calculating pleasant smile, rings on his fingers, a ledger tablet under his arm
proscriptions.scene_dictator_law: the Roman senate house, near empty: a single bronze tablet on a stand, rows of vacant benches, a lictor's bundle of rods leaning by the door, oppressive silence
proscriptions.scene_lists_forum: a whitewashed wall on the Roman forum covered with posted name-lists on wooden boards, a small table with a money box and scales, crumpled tablets on the ground
proscriptions.scene_spare_youth: a private room in a Roman house: a curtained doorway, a stool, a bowl of water, a shaft of afternoon light across a mosaic floor, quiet and tense

spartacus.char_spartacus: Spartacus, a Thracian gladiator: a powerful man in a patched tunic with broken shackles still on one wrist, dark shoulder-length hair, a short curved thracian sword, steady defiant eyes
spartacus.char_crixus: Crixus, a Gaulish gladiator: a huge red-haired Gaul, bare chest with old scars, a heavy axe over his shoulder, wild grin
spartacus.scene_capua_ludus: the training yard of a gladiator school: a sanded ring, wooden practice posts, barred cell doors along one side, a rack of blunt weapons, kitchen knives left on a bench, hot glare
spartacus.scene_decimation: a Roman camp parade ground at grey dawn: an empty formation square marked in the dirt, a helmet upturned with lots inside on a stool, a single centurion's vine staff, bleak
spartacus.scene_appian_way: a long straight Roman road lined with tall bare wooden crosses receding to the horizon, umbrella pines, dust, sombre evening light, no bodies and no figures
spartacus.scene_senate_triumph: an anteroom of the senate: a laurel wreath on a cushion, two sealed dispatch scrolls on a table, a curtained doorway, cool marble

pirates.char_gabinius: Aulus Gabinius, a Roman tribune: an energetic middle-aged man in a toga, arm outstretched proposing a law, a sea chart in his other hand
pirates.char_catulus: Quintus Lutatius Catulus, an old Roman senator: white-haired, deeply lined face, plain toga, one hand raised in grave warning
pirates.char_archipirate: a Cilician arch-pirate: a lean weather-burnt sea captain in a sleeveless leather jerkin, a red headscarf, gold hoop earring, a boarding axe at his belt, wary calculating grin
pirates.scene_lex_gabinia: the Roman forum during a law vote with the sea in mind: a big painted chart of the Mediterranean propped on the rostra, voting urns, gulls on the roof tiles, bright light
pirates.scene_sea_sweep: an open blue sea divided by distant squadron sails on the horizon, empty foreground water and a rocky Cilician cape, clear hard daylight, no ships in front
pirates.scene_pirate_farms: a newly settled inland valley: fresh furrows, a plough, young olive trees, a rough new farmhouse, the sea nowhere in sight, warm calm light
pirates.scene_pirate_crosses: a rocky coastline with bare wooden crosses standing along the cliff edge above the surf, grey sky, cold wind, no figures

catilina.char_catilina: Lucius Sergius Catilina: a gaunt aristocratic Roman with hollow burning eyes, an expensive but disordered toga, unshaven, one hand hidden in the folds of cloth
catilina.char_lentulus: Publius Lentulus Sura: a heavy self-satisfied Roman praetor in a fine toga, thinning hair, holding a folded sealed letter
catilina.scene_senate_oratio: the Roman senate house during a speech: tiers of benches with an empty semicircle of space left around one isolated seat, a consul's curule chair, dusty light shafts
catilina.scene_allobroges: a night interception on a bridge outside Rome: a dropped satchel spilling sealed letters, a lantern on the parapet, mist over the river, no figures
catilina.scene_caesar_speech: the senate floor at night lit by lamps: benches, a speaker's spot marked on the mosaic, an unrolled law scroll on a stand, deep shadows
catilina.scene_tullianum: the underground stone execution chamber of the Tullianum: a round hole in the vaulted ceiling, damp black walls, a coil of rope, a single guttering lamp

philippi.scene_philippi_first: a wide Macedonian plain at dawn seen from a low ridge: two marked camp lines with earthworks and ditches, marsh reeds on one side, dropped standards, morning mist, no figures
philippi.scene_cassius_tent: the inside of a Roman general's campaign tent at dusk: a folding stool tipped over, a sword lying on a spread cloak, a helmet on a chest, one oil lamp, heavy shadow, no figures
philippi.scene_philippi_second: the same Macedonian plain three weeks later, churned mud and broken palisade stakes, scattered shields, low grey sky, rain starting, no figures
philippi.scene_caesar_ghost: a dim Roman command tent at night lit by one failing lamp, a writing desk with scrolls, an empty camp chair, a strange pale glow at the tent opening, unsettling, no figures

alexandria.scene_parley_a: a bare guarded chamber in a Ptolemaic palace: two chairs facing each other, a low table with an untouched cup, tall doors, hard daylight through a high window, no figures
alexandria.scene_triumph_rome: a Roman triumphal street seen empty before the procession: laurel garlands on balconies, a waiting gilded chariot, chains and captive placards laid on a cart, bright harsh noon, no figures

rubicon.scene_senate_ultimatum: the Roman senate house interior at night, a single bronze decree tablet propped on a stand, empty benches in shadow, a lictor's bundle of rods leaning by the door, cold lamplight, no figures

pharsalus.scene_pompey_camp: a Roman army camp decked for a victory feast before the battle: tents dressed with myrtle garlands, tables laid with silver cups and wine jars, couches set out, bright confident afternoon light, no figures

tarsus.scene_summons_t: a Roman tribunal set up in a provincial Greek town square: an empty curule chair on a low wooden dais, standards planted, a scribe's table with tablets, harsh noon light, no figures
tarsus.scene_pearl_feast: an opulent Hellenistic banquet chamber: low couches with purple cushions, a table with gold cups and a small dish of vinegar, hanging lamps, rose petals on the floor, warm night light, no figures

discord.scene_donations_d: a Ptolemaic ceremonial dais in Alexandria: two golden thrones on a silver platform, smaller thrones beside them, provincial standards and crowns laid on cushions, bright Mediterranean light, no figures
discord.scene_will_read_d: the Roman senate house with a single unrolled papyrus will on a stand, wax seals broken, tiers of empty benches, shafts of dusty light, tense emptiness, no figures

actium.scene_line_of_battle_a: a naval battle line at dawn seen from above: heavy Roman warships drawn up across a gulf mouth, a separate squadron of Egyptian ships with purple sails held behind the line, calm sea, no crew visible
actium.scene_flight_a: open sea seen from a deck rail: a squadron of purple-sailed ships receding south under full canvas, abandoned oars and a dropped standard in the foreground, hazy afternoon, no figures

augustus.char_agrippa: Marcus Agrippa: a solid Roman commander in a plain muscled cuirass and dark red cloak, cropped hair, blunt practical face, an engineer's rolled plan under one arm
augustus.char_munatius: Munatius Plancus: an elderly Roman senator in a white toga with purple stripe, thinning grey hair, one hand raised making a formal proposal, shrewd courtier's face
augustus.scene_resign_curia: the Roman senate house interior, a lone empty speaker's spot on the marble floor, tiers of benches, a laurel wreath and a bundle of scrolls laid down on the steps as if surrendered, cold shafts of light, no figures
augustus.scene_grant_curia: the Roman senate house in celebration: laurel garlands draped on the benches, a golden shield propped on a stand, an inscribed bronze tablet, warm light, no figures
augustus.scene_diadem_offer: a white cushion on a low table holding a golden royal diadem, a purple cloth beside it, marble columns behind, tempting and ominous, no figures

sejanus.char_tiberius_princeps: the emperor Tiberius in old age: a tall gaunt Roman in a plain dark toga, sour closed face, thin grey hair, holding a sealed letter
sejanus.char_sejanus: Sejanus, prefect of the guard: a fit ambitious Roman officer in a decorated praetorian cuirass, close beard, confident predatory smile, sword at hip
sejanus.char_macro: Macro, a praetorian officer: a hard-faced Roman soldier in plain guard armour, scarred jaw, watchful and expressionless
sejanus.char_memmius: Memmius Regulus, a Roman consul: a careful middle-aged senator in a toga, unrolling a long papyrus letter, cautious expression
sejanus.scene_capri_villa: a cliff-top Roman villa on a Mediterranean island: colonnaded terrace, sea far below, cypresses, a couch with cushions, empty and isolated, bright hard light, no figures
sejanus.scene_guard_swap: a praetorian guardroom at night: a rack of standards and helmets, a wax tablet with orders on a table, a heavy key, lamplight, no figures
sejanus.scene_long_letter: the Roman senate house mid-session seen empty: a very long unrolled papyrus draped over a reading stand, benches, closed bronze doors, tense stillness, no figures

claudius_mushrooms.char_claudius: the emperor Claudius: an ageing scholarly Roman in an imperial toga, slightly stooped, kind distracted face, holding a book scroll
claudius_mushrooms.char_agrippina: Agrippina the Younger: an imperial Roman lady in a rich stola and pearl diadem, elaborate braided hair, beautiful and utterly composed, cold calculating eyes
claudius_mushrooms.char_nero: the young Nero: a plump teenage Roman in a purple-bordered tunic, curled reddish hair, soft petulant face, a lyre held loosely
claudius_mushrooms.char_britannicus: Britannicus: a slight Roman boy of thirteen in a plain white tunic with purple border, serious wary face
claudius_mushrooms.scene_adoption_c: a formal Roman palace hall with a bronze adoption tablet on a stand, curule chair, family masks in wall niches, solemn warm light, no figures
claudius_mushrooms.scene_mushroom_dish: an imperial Roman dining room: a couch, a low table with a silver dish of mushrooms, an overturned cup, a feather lying on the floor, lamplight, sinister calm, no figures
claudius_mushrooms.scene_praetorian_camp: the praetorian camp parade ground: a raised tribunal platform, standards planted, a chest of coins open beside it, hard morning light, no figures

nero_fire.char_tigellinus: Tigellinus, praetorian prefect: a heavy brutal Roman officer in dark guard armour, thick neck, cruel amused expression
nero_fire.char_thrasea: Thrasea Paetus, a stoic Roman senator: a lean austere man in a plain white toga, calm unyielding face, arms folded
nero_fire.scene_fire_night: Rome burning at night seen from a hill: insula tenements collapsing in flame, orange smoke over the whole skyline, embers in the air, no figures
nero_fire.scene_lyre_roof: a palace rooftop terrace at night facing a burning city: a lyre resting on a marble bench, a wine cup, the glow of fire on the columns, no figures
nero_fire.scene_scapegoat_n: a Roman prison yard at dusk: chains and iron collars on the stone floor, a barred door, a brazier, cold cruel emptiness, no figures
nero_fire.scene_golden_house: a vast opulent palace under construction: gilded coffered ceiling, marble colonnade, an artificial lake with scaffolding around a colossal statue's feet, bright ostentatious light, no figures

four_emperors.char_galba: Galba, an aged Roman emperor: gaunt severe old man in imperial toga, bald with a hooked nose, gouty hands, tight-lipped and stingy
four_emperors.char_otho: Otho, a Roman claimant: a dandyish young noble in a fine toga, carefully arranged wig-like hair, smooth charming face

vesuvius.char_rectina: Rectina, a Roman lady: a frightened well-dressed woman in a dusty stola, shawl over her hair, a sealed note clutched in her hand
